sentiment.label: neutral
sentiment.reason_it: I mercati azionari hanno chiuso la scorsa settimana con un tono positivo, S&P 500 +0.37% e STOXX 600 +0.88%. Il VIX è sceso a 16.70, segnalando una riduzione della volatilità. Tuttavia, le preoccupazioni sull'inflazione e sui tassi di interesse rimangono, con il CPI USA al 3.9% e il Core CPI al 3.0%. La BCE ha mantenuto i tassi fermi al 2.00% (DFR) e 2.15% (Refi).
sentiment.reason_en: The equity markets ended the previous week on a positive note, with S&P 500 up 0.37% and STOXX 600 up 0.88%. The VIX decreased to 16.70, indicating reduced volatility. However, concerns about inflation and interest rates persist, with US CPI at 3.9% and Core CPI at 3.0%. The ECB kept rates steady at 2.00% (DFR) and 2.15% (Refi).

market_impact_summary.it: La chiusura precedente ha visto un sentiment neutro, con i mercati azionari che hanno guadagnato leggermente. Il DXY è salito dello 0.13%, mentre il TLT Bond USA 20Y è salito dello 0.55%. Il petrolio è sceso del 2.31%, influenzando negativamente il sentiment. La BCE e la Fed manterranno i tassi fermi nella prossima riunione.
market_impact_summary.en: The previous close saw a neutral sentiment, with equity markets slightly up. The DXY rose 0.13%, while the TLT Bond USA 20Y gained 0.55%. Oil prices dropped 2.31%, negatively impacting sentiment. The ECB and Fed are expected to keep rates steady in their upcoming meetings.

audio_script_it:
Buongiorno, benvenuti al Morning Briefing di Price Alert.

I mercati asiatici hanno chiuso con segno positivo. Il Nikkei ha chiuso in rialzo del 2.68%, Shanghai in aumento dello 0.87%, e l'Hang Seng di Hong Kong ha guadagnato lo 0.86%.

Mentre i mercati tradizionali sono chiusi per il fine settimana, riassumiamo la chiusura precedente. L'S&P 500 ha chiuso in rialzo dello 0.37%, con il VIX in calo dello 0.36%. Il Dollar Index è salito dello 0.13%, mentre l'oro è sceso dello 0.37% a $4523.2 l'oncia. Il petrolio Brent è sceso del 2.31% a $100.21

Sul fronte macro, nessun dato rilevante in uscita oggi. La Global M2 Liquidity continua ad espandersi, con un aumento del 4.6% su base annua.

Tra le notizie, spiccano le dichiarazioni di Karen Ward di Jp Morgan Am, che suggerisce all'UE di puntare su tassi fermi e più investimenti pubblici. Inoltre, Kevin Warsh ha assunto la carica di chairman del Federal Reserve System.

La situazione geopolitica rimane tesa, con l'Ucraina che potrebbe essere oggetto di un attacco russo su larga scala secondo l'Ambasciata Usa.

Passiamo ora al comparto degli asset digitali. Bitcoin si mantiene sopra i settantacinquemila dollari, con un guadagno del 2,92% nella giornata. I flussi ETF hanno registrato una salida di 105,2 milioni di dollari. Questo movimento potrebbe essere influenzato dalle dichiarazioni di alcuni analisti che prevedono tagli ai tassi, nonostante la tendenza sia verso aumenti. Inoltre, la notizia di un accordo di pace tra gli Stati Uniti e l'Iran ha contribuito a推动 la crescita di Bitcoin.

Ethereum guadagna il 4,54%, raggiungendo i duemilacentodieciotto dollari. Solana e BNB mostrano anch'esse variazioni positive, con guadagni del 4,90% e del 3,00%, rispettivamente. 

Il Fear & Greed Index è a 25, nella zona di Extreme Fear, suggerisce cautela sugli investitori.

Nessun dato macro in agenda oggi. Per approfondire i temi di oggi, sulla nostra piattaforma trovate gli articoli completi nella sezione Storie in Primo Piano. Grazie per l'attenzione e a domani.
audio_script_en: Good morning, welcome to the Price Alert Morning Briefing. Asian markets closed on a positive note. The Nikkei rose 2.68%, Shanghai gained 0.87%, and Hong Kong's Hang Seng increased 0.86%. While traditional markets are closed for the weekend, let's recap the previous close. The S&P 500 rose 0.37%, with the VIX down 0.36%. The Dollar Index edged up 0.13%, while gold fell 0.37% to $4523.2 per ounce. Brent crude oil dropped 2.31% to $100.21 On the macro front, there's no significant data due today. Global M2 Liquidity continues to expand, up 4.6% year-over-year. Among the news, Karen Ward of Jp Morgan Am stands out, suggesting the EU should focus on steady rates and more public investment. Additionally, Kevin Warsh has taken on the role of chairman of the Federal Reserve System. The geopolitical situation remains tense, with Ukraine potentially facing a large-scale Russian attack, according to the US Embassy. Let's pivot to the cryptocurrency markets. Bitcoin holds above seventy-five thousand dollars, with a 2.92% gain today. ETF flows saw an outflow of $105.2 million. This movement might be influenced by analysts' statements predicting rate cuts, despite the trend being towards hikes. Furthermore, news of a peace agreement between the US and Iran contributed to Bitcoin's growth. Ethereum gains 4.54%, reaching $2,018 Solana and BNB also show positive variations, with gains of 4.9% and 3%, respectively. The Fear & Greed Index is at 25, in the Extreme Fear zone, suggesting caution among investors. No macro data is on the agenda today. For a deeper dive into today's topics, find the full articles in the Top Stories section on our platform. Thanks for your attention, and we'll see you tomorrow.

articles.title: What does it mean to be "European" today?
articles.snippet: The idea of Europe as a community emerged many centuries ago, but its meaning keeps changing—to Europeans and non-Europeans alike. Juliet Johnson has pioneered research on the changing role of European symbols such as the 12-starred flag, designed in the 1950s and formally adopted by European institutions in the 1980s. Intriguingly, shifts in meaning have often first occurred on Europe's eastern side, before being adopted by Europe's western "core." What does it mean to be European today, in a fast-changing geopolitical environment and amid debates on which new member countries the European…

articles.title: Norway Doubles Down on Oil and Gas as Europe Scrambles for Supply
articles.snippet: Norway, well known for its oil and gas production, has ramped up its fossil fuel output in recent weeks to fill the gap following the closure of the Strait of Hormuz and the ongoing energy trade disruptions. articles.title: Even if the Iran war ended today, US fuel prices aren’t likely to normalize this year
articles.snippet: Prewar US gas prices averaged about $3 a gallon nationally – kiss that number goodbye for 2026 Sorry, US drivers, but don’t expect pump prices to return to prewar levels any time soon, even if the US and Iran agree to a lasting peace deal tomorrow. As the war with Iran enters its third month, drivers have become infuriated by rising gas prices – and inflation – and Donald Trump is facing a historic backlash in the polls. The president promised recently that relief will be swift once the war ends. “I see it going down very substantially when this is over, I think very rapidly too, at levels that you’ve never seen,” he said. Continue reading...

articles.title: EU's 20th Sanctions Package Forces Kyrgyzstan's Hand on Russia Trade
articles.snippet: Kyrgyzstan has taken sweeping action to clamp down on companies suspected of circumventing Western sanctions imposed on Russia following its full-scale invasion of Ukraine in 2022. The Kyrgyz Justice Ministry has announced that 50 companies will be forced to suspend their activities after they had been flagged by Western partners. "After they report risks, we study them and respond. For example, the United States and the United Kingdom have made allegations regarding 51 companies," Deputy Prime Minister Daniyar Amangeldiev told state news agency…
